purpose: Commission bounded GPU execution and named force sampling before quadruped candidate training. Measure disagreement, do not declare equivalence.
source_rule: Clean LoColemotion main equal to live origin/main; one fresh attempt directory; complete zero-world gate before construction.
inputs: Eight seeded initial velocities in [-0.2,0.2]; targets [-0.75,-0.6,-0.1,0,0.1,0.6,0.75,1.0], sign reversal after 60 steps. Same numeric values projected to GPU float32 and explicitly retained.
telemetry: Every CPU/GPU cell and step: pre/post velocity, command, completed-step named actuator and joint force sensors, post-state force evaluation, scalar momentum impulse and simulated time. Retain original logs and partial traces on failure.
experimental_training_successor: Candidate-generating search and provisional fitting may proceed through a distinct bounded development contract; promotion still requires independent native validation. This probe itself authorizes neither training nor old sealed calibration campaigns.
